settings.title: Settings
settings.themeDescription: Light or dark interface. The canvas follows the same theme.
settings.diagramStyleDescription: How the AI draws new diagrams: Styled uses colors and icons, Minimal keeps shapes plain.
settings.sendShortcutDescription: Shift+Enter always adds a new line, and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter always sends.
settings.proxyDescription: Configure HTTP/HTTPS proxy for API requests (Desktop only)
settings.diagramValidationDescription: After each drawing, a model that can read images looks at a screenshot and asks for fixes. Needs a model that can read images.
settings.customSystemMessageDescription: Add custom instructions appended to the AI's system prompt.
settings.customSystemMessagePlaceholder: e.g., Always use blue color scheme for diagrams...
settings.maxOutputTokensDescription: Budget for one reply, shared by thinking and the diagram XML. Raise it if the AI keeps thinking and no diagram appears. Leave empty for the default.
settings.proxyInvalid: Proxy addresses must start with http:// or https://

errors.invalidAccessCode: Invalid or missing access code. Please configure it in Settings.
